name: Set File Metadata
description: Set the application metadata of a file or directory in DLFS, under a DLFS-backed root or by canonical DLFS path, or clear it with null. Host and temp roots keep no metadata. The value is kept with the entry: a move or rename takes it along, replacing the file's content in place keeps it, and deleting the entry removes it. The entry's content and modified time are unchanged. file_stat returns it as 'metadata'.
creator: Covia

root.description: Configured DLFS-backed root name; omit for a canonical DLFS path

path.description: Path of an existing file or directory, relative to root, or a canonical DLFS path

metadata.description: The value to keep with the entry, replacing any it had. Use structured values (objects/arrays/scalars). Null clears it.
The metadata the entry now has, null for none
